description: This file defines the EmployeePictureService class, which manages employee profile pictures in the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving, saving, resizing images, and handling caching and ETag management.

classes.name: EmployeePictureService
classes.description: Service class to handle employee picture operations, including retrieval, caching, resizing, and access control.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeePictureDao, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: pictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Resizes a picture to fit within 200x200 pixels, maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Saves the given employee picture via DAO.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture by employee number.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture if the current user has access rights.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag associated with an employee's picture, using cache if available.

methods.name: deleteEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes the ETag cache for the given employee number.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and caches the ETag for an employee's picture.

methods.name: generateEmpPictureETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for the employee picture's ETag.
